pride_data.title: Human HeLa cells SREBP2-TurboID-MS
pride_data.projectDescription: We employed the TurboID proximity labeling approach to map the interactome of SREBP2 with mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: HeLa cells stably expressing Turbo-SREBP2 were generated by lentiviral infection and selection with Puromycin (2 μg/mL) for five days. Cells were cultured in complete medium or cholesterol-depleted medium for 16 hr and then labelled with 50 μM Biotin for 2 hr in the same medium. After washing three times with cold PBS, cells were scraped off and lysed in RIPA buffer with 1*protease inhibitors cocktail (Roche) on ice. After centrifugation at 13,000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C, supernatants were incubated with 100 μL of Streptavidin-agarose on a rotator at 4 °C overnight. Beads were then washed twice with RIPA buffer, once with 1 M KCl, once with 0.1 M Na2CO3, once with 2 M urea in 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), twice with RIPA buffer, and three times with PBS. After resuspended in 200 μL 1 M Urea and 1 mM DTT in 50 mM NH4HCO3, then the beads were placed in ThermoMixer (5384000071, Eppendorf) at 500 rpm for 1 hr at 4 °C, following which 2 mM IAM was added, and the reaction was incubated for 45 min at room temperature in the dark. Trypsin was added at a ratio 100:1 and proteins were digested for 4 hr at 37 °C. Peptides were separated from beads, vacuum centrifuged to near-dryness and desalted via StageTip.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: The raw data were processed and searched with MaxQuant 1.5.4.1 with MS tolerance of 4.5 ppm, and MS/MS tolerance of 20 ppm. The UniProt human protein database (release 2016_07, 70630 sequences) and database for proteomics contaminants from MaxQuant were used for database searches. Reversed database searches were used to evaluate false discovery rate (FDR) of peptide and protein identifications. Two missed cleavage sites of trypsin were allowed. Carbamidomethylation (C) was set as a fixed modification, and oxidation (M), Acetyl (Protein N-term), and deamidation (NQ) were set as variable modifications. The FDR of both peptide identification and protein identification was set to be 1%. The options of “Second peptides,” “Match between runs,” and “Dependent peptides” were enabled. Label-free quantification was used to quantify the difference of protein abundances between different samples.
